Built coAgent, a private coding agent with a five-phase tool loop, repository retrieval and test-driven verification, published on PyPI; SnapToSpot, a multi-tenant pipeline that grounds every generated claim in a retrieved source; and PlusOne, an agent pipeline with budget guards and partial-run recovery. At SautiFlow Labs built the agentic podcast pipeline and the voice design, TTS, cloning and speech-to-text services behind local Kenyan languages. Strong Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL, with hands-on RAG, evaluation and deployment on AWS, GCP and Render.

competencies.items: Planning and verification loops, tool and function calling, structured outputs, RAG with BM25 and vector search, agent state machines, human approval and guardrails; podcast production agents (research → script → casting → render → master → show notes)

jobs.title: Freelance AI Engineer
bullets: Built coAgent, a private coding agent for Colab's free T4: a survey → plan → act → verify → report loop, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B at NF4, tree-sitter and BM25 retrieval, Ruff and pytest verification, and a git checkpoint per verified step; published 0.2.1 to PyPI.
Built SnapToSpot, a multi-tenant FastAPI service (OAuth2, Alembic, PostgreSQL/pgvector) that turns a website into a campaign kit, rendering only facts that trace to an accepted source.
Built PlusOne's agent pipeline: typed event stream, content-addressed photo store, budget-aware orchestration and resumable runs that return completed work with refunds instead of losing it.
Shipped Vocalis, EchoID and FaceForm with provider-agnostic model adapters, credit ledgers, idempotent M-Pesa and Stripe settlement, and evaluation of provider output before release.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
bullets: Cut Swahili and Sheng ASR word error rate from 23.4% to 11.8% by LoRA fine-tuning Whisper-large-v3 on 1,240 curated hours, comparing runs on held-out and noisy field sets before promotion.
Built the evaluation harness — WER, CER, MOS and CI regression gates — which blocked 9 model regressions from release in two quarters and set the experiment-tracking standard across 60+ runs a month.
Shipped streaming speech synthesis at 310 ms median / 780 ms p95 first-audio latency across Swahili, Sheng, Luo and Kikuyu, deploying model services on FastAPI, Triton and Kubernetes.
Compressed a 1.6 GB TTS checkpoint to 480 MB with int8 quantisation and KV caching: 42 concurrent voices per GPU, 3.1x throughput and 58% lower inference cost.

Built the agentic podcast pipeline — research, script, casting, render, mastering and show-notes agents — with source-span provenance and human approval gates, alongside 12 Kenyan-language voice personas and cloning from 3 – 5 minutes of consented audio.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Designed batch and streaming pipelines (Airflow, Kafka, Spark) processing 6 TB / 38,000 hours of raw audio a year into training-ready datasets.
Introduced DVC versioning with content hashing so every model release traces to an exact data snapshot; consolidated 14 schemas into a dbt warehouse, cutting compute spend 23%.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built REST and WebSocket APIs in Django and Node.js handling 1.2M requests a day at p95 latency under 140 ms, and introduced Docker deploys with GitHub Actions CI/CD.
Took front-end test coverage from 0 to 71% and cut reported production bugs 34% by adding regression tests around the payment and voice flows.

projects.name: coAgent — Private Coding Agent for Colab
projects.description: Python coding agent for Google Colab's free T4: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B runs locally at NF4, plans inside the repository, edits with a tree-sitter map and BM25 retrieval, verifies with Ruff and pytest, and commits every checkpoint to an isolated git branch. Published on PyPI as co-agent-coder 0.2.1 — no API keys or per-token cost.

projects.name: SnapToSpot — Website-to-Campaign Pipeline
projects.description: Turns a website into a five-platform campaign kit — stills, video, poster and copy deck — built only from facts the site can support. The model writes the words and structure, a deterministic renderer sets the type, and every number traces to a source span. FastAPI, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Alembic and OAuth2; in active development.

projects.name: PlusOne — Personal AI Photography
projects.description: Builds a photo story from an event brief, the people in it and a few reference photos, keeping identities consistent across every shot. Studio, photo feed, albums and a credit ledger, backed by an agent pipeline with content-addressed dedupe, budget guards and partial-run recovery.
